talks.text: Which country has lost the most wars in history? And which ones have never lost a single one? Every war between countries since 1816. 197 countries, one by one.
Grey: never fought a war.
Green: fought, but never lost.
Yellow: one war lost.
Orange: two.
Red: three or four.
And purple... five or more! Let's go!
United States: two wars lost, including the Vietnam War.
Two losses... and we don't talk about Vietnam.
Canada: zero wars lost! Two won.
Mexico: one war lost: the Mexican-American War.
Just one war... and we lost half our territory.
United Kingdom: zero wars lost! Ten won.
Ten wars won, zero lost. Rule, Britannia!
